description: Applies to repositories containing CLI code.

dos: These conventions apply to repositories containing CLI application code.
CLI application repositories must explicitly list both application.json and this profile in package.json.eliware.apply.
donts: CLI application repositories must not omit application.json or applicable CLI requirements.

dos: Every CLI repository must extend the general AGENTS.md requirements with applicable CLI guidance.
donts: A CLI repository must not omit AGENTS.md.

dos: After the seven general AGENTS.md headings, add a ## CLI section. Document each executable entrypoint and its target; command/subcommand names; option and positional-argument parsing, defaults, validation, forwarding, and errors; exit-code meanings and mapping; supported platforms and platform-specific behavior; --help and --version behavior; and destructive-action safeguards such as dry-run, confirmation, and scope limits. Include applicable validation commands.
donts: AGENTS.md must not leave CLI entrypoints or required CLI validation undefined.

dos: CLI applications must contain bin/ with the executable entrypoint, implement and document --help and --version, and document exit codes and redacted output. Human review must identify each command that can change or delete state; each such command must provide dry-run, confirmation, or an equivalent safeguard. A CLI with no state-changing or destructive commands requires no destructive-action safeguard.
donts: CLI applications must not omit bin/, --help, --version, or safeguards for state-changing commands, or expose secrets. Deterministic checks must not infer destructive behavior from command names or keyword presence.

dos: Under the Commands and Exit codes headings assigned to cli by general.json, document installation, each user-facing command and important options, --help, --version, safe copyable examples, supported platform behavior, exit-code meanings, and destructive-action controls. Include the headings in the Table of Contents as required by general.json.
donts: Do not show a destructive command without dry-run, confirmation, or equivalent safety behavior; do not require these controls when the CLI has no destructive commands. State supported platforms separately from CI-tested platforms; label platforms without validation evidence as unverified.
